2.  RECOMMENDATION TO REVIEW THE APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED FOR THE VACANT CITY
  COUNCIL SEAT, HEAR PRESENTATIONS FROM THE APPLICANTS, AND EITHER: (I) ADOPT
  RESOLUTION NO. 014­2022 TO APPOINT AN INDIVIDUAL TO THE CITY COUNCIL SEAT
  RESULTING FROM COUNCILMEMBER MARAVILLA’S RESIGNATION; OR (II) DIRECT STAFF
  AS TO AN ALTERNATIVE REVIEW PROCESS BY WHICH THE CITY COUNCIL WOULD
  PROCEED FOR AN APPOINTMENT.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council appoint one of the three
  applicants to the vacant City Council seat resulting from Councilmember Maravilla’s resignation
  via Resolution No. 014­2022. If the Council appoints someone to fill this seat, this person would
  serve until November 2022 (which is when the next general municipal elections will be held)
